meta.title: Mise environments
meta.description: Pins project toolchains with mise: inspects mise.toml and the trust state, installs the declared tools (optionally from mise.lock), and runs commands and tasks with the project's environment. Adds the mise_status, mise_prepare, and mise_run tools. Installations write to mise's own data directories, and mise.lock is only created or refreshed when a prepare call asks for it.
